# Drawing 522-35.4179СБ evidence review

Date: 2026-10-06 UTC. Source revision: `4222b3d4df248b07777315068b9f3c99273d47c4` in `reknottycat/valve-agent-design`. This is a source correction and standards applicability record for engineering review, not a manufacturing release or product certification.

## Main conclusions

The original drawings must replace the C0 summaries as the working source of truth. C0 has propagated several material misreadings: variant-specific brine duty became a universal duty, a vertical spindle/disc section became an inclined swing-disc model, a mechanical locking note became an IP rating, the explicit 600 mm reference length was missed, and a pressure standard became a gasket standard. These affect the service contract, mechanism, calculations, CAD, and verification plan.

The drawing does not establish a complete pressure design basis, exact material grades, complete component dimensions, or a certified test acceptance basis. A new candidate can be developed with explicit proposed choices. The missing evidence cannot be replaced by catalog analogies or by apparently precise numerical results.

## Primary drawing evidence

The two small repository JPEGs were fetched using the GitHub connector at the immutable source revision. Local SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 were recomputed from decoded bytes. The latter match the GitHub tree. No dimensions were obtained by measuring the image scale.

| Source | Repository filename | Local SHA256 |
|---|---|---|
| Requirements and variant table | `runs/20261006/C0/T01/00_inputs/522-35.4179SB_sheet1.jpg` | `c9e5da28d1d9e43ed3903c91f62777dc36d94c5dd32e486ab3fce5727afb8008` |
| Main section and geometry | `runs/20261006/C0/T01/00_inputs/522-35.4179SB_sheet2.jpg` | `9401cc66f20f95fbf7dcc6dbbd820f64a848e98dd4a0ebcfa4f80471ebbaa25b` |

The C0 manifest and contract record a different SHA256 for the geometry JPEG, although its byte count matches. Retain the historical discrepancy and update future provenance to the recomputed digest; do not say the old digest was verified.

### Variant applicability is part of the drawing

The table heading is “Применяемые пункты т.т.”, applicable technical-requirement clauses. Its rows read:

| Drawing variant | Figure | Purpose marking | Applicable notes | Mass |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| 522-35.4179 | 1 | РЗ, ПЗ | 1, 3, 4, 6, 7–17, 19–31 | 119.0 kg |
| 522-35.4179-01 | 2 | ПЗ | 1, 3, 4, 7, 10–13, 15, 16, 18–26, 29–31 | 111.0 kg |
| 522-35.4179-02 | 2 | ТПФ | 2–5, 10–13, 15, 16, 21, 24, 29–31 | 111.0 kg |

Evidence: `sources/variant_table.png`. Purpose abbreviations are transcribed, not expanded or interpreted as a classification approval. The table is a variant schedule, not a component BOM.

| Requirement | Drawing note | Base | -01 | -02 | Consequence |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Seawater, −2 to +50 °C | 4 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Confirmed operating-medium range for all listed variants |
| 28% calcium-chloride solution, −40 to +50 °C | 5 | No | No | Yes | Do not assign brine duty to the unsuffixed base |
| Time distribution of pressure/temperature, protocol Л-ПСП-4035-85 | 6 | Yes | No | No | Base duty-cycle protocol remains missing |
| Service and operating-resource figures | 8 | Yes | No | No | Do not propagate base lifetime figures to suffix variants |
| Preserved non-operating storage, −45 to +32 °C | 9 | Yes | No | No | Distinguish storage exposure from pressurized operating duty |
| 9.5 handwheel turns, reference | 19 | Yes | Yes | No | Do not assign to -02 from this drawing alone |
| Auxiliary wrench effort ≤45 kgf at nominal pressure | 20 | Yes | Yes | No | Effort is not an automatic handwheel-rim limit |
| Shock requirement, class 2 | 22 | Yes | Yes | No | Exact test method/source still required |
| Vibration per ОСТ В5.4347-81, group A | 23 | Yes | Yes | No | Vibration note, not hydraulic-coefficient note |
| Hydraulic resistance coefficient ≤6 | 24 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Tap locations, reference velocity, operating position and flow domain are not specified here |
| Airborne noise ≤70 dB, МКШС-71Е method | 25 | Yes | Yes | No | Does not supply CFD acoustic boundary conditions |
| Reliability 0.97 over 5000 continuous hours | 27 | Yes | No | No | Calculation/test evidence is still missing |
| Climate execution ОМ5 per ГОСТ15150-69 | 29 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Retain exact designation pending full-clause review |
| Mechanical locking per РД5.9307-79 | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | No IP55/IP54 requirement is evidenced by this note |
| Asterisked dimensions are reference dimensions | 31 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Preserve asterisks in all derived drawings |

### Geometry and mechanism corrections

The main section visibly shows a vertical central spindle and a disc/seat assembly across the passage. The top circular item is a handwheel, marked Ø320*. A lower hinge, inclined 45° swing disc, and weighted lever are not evidenced. A vertical-lift stop-check interpretation is a reasonable mechanism hypothesis from the assembly section; the exact free-lift travel, spindle-to-disc connection, guides, anti-rotation features and check-action sequence require detail verification.

The bottom dimension explicitly reads 600*. It is a reference face-to-face dimension, not an absent dimension and not a newly frozen manufacturing tolerance. Other legible reference annotations include DN200/title marking, Ø295*, Ø264*, Ø247*, 515*, Ø320*, and a 12-hole Ø15* pattern. Labels and detailed geometry require independent verification before controlling a manufacturing drawing. In particular, Ø247 should not silently be called a body hub OD without checking the dimension's endpoints and flange standard definition.

The claim that the entire drawing has no controlled dimensions is too broad. The enlarged screw/locking detail contains M6-7H and toleranced dimensions without asterisks. That does not make the complete valve manufacturable from this assembly drawing. No unannotated disc diameter, seat width, wall thickness, hinge arm, or closing inclination was measured from pixels.

Evidence crops: `sources/spindle_disc_section.png`, `sources/length600_reference.png`, `sources/fastener_detail.png`; full main section is visible in the original geometry image. Crops are inspection aids; originals remain unmodified.

## Standards evidence matrix

Public registry status below was checked on 2026-10-06. “Active” means the registry's status; it does not establish the required jurisdiction, ship class, contract edition, or acceptance authority for this project. Do not silently modernize a legacy controlled drawing.

| Reference | Verified evidence | Applicability and remaining limitation |
|---|---|---|
| [ГОСТ1536-76](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/23b3dd83-c416-4ccf-ae9c-77f26bdaffdb) | Active; effective 1977-07-01; changes 1/2/3 listed in 1982/1987/1992; ship-flange coupling and sealing-face scope | Drawing note10 directly cites it. This is not a valve face-to-face, body-material, or complete pressure-design standard. Public full-document viewer returned no pages |
| [ГОСТ356-80](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/8ffe7e89-ad99-4d7d-86b0-b48f85461d3a) | Active; effective 1981-01-01; pressure series; 2011 change and 2024 correction listed | Drawing note3 directly cites it for pressure. C0 “asbestos gasket” role is wrong. Exact material/temperature row and pressure basis are not verified; official viewer requires login |
| [ГОСТ613-79](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/986384b4-a6f9-4785-8e31-4fcba2cc631f) | Active; effective 1980-01-01; tin casting bronze grades | Candidate material-reference standard, not a source drawing grade assignment. Official viewer returned no pages |
| [ГОСТ493-79](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/d3b897cd-4465-442c-8020-3090606151f4) | Active; effective 1980-01-01; tin-free casting bronze grades | Candidate material-reference standard; no equivalency or allowable-stress value adopted |
| [ГОСТ33260-2015](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/11d70733-a4b2-4c09-a8ed-960ff2f316cd) | Active; effective 2016-04-01; material selection scope includes ship-system valves and pressure, temperature, fluid chemistry and service conditions | Useful modern material-selection review candidate. Not cited by this legacy drawing; acceptance requires an applicability decision. Full official viewer requires login |
| [ГОСТ33257-2015](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/61cb855a-0504-42bf-9d89-9c840500af35) | Active; effective 2016-04-01; valve control/testing methods | Modern test-plan candidate. Does not prove a test was performed or set the product's missing service pressure |
| [ГОСТ9544-2015](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/9764ef23-58b2-412b-ad5c-4641744820a5) | Active; effective 2016-04-01; shutoff leakage classes/rates; 2016 and 2022 corrections listed | Modern leakage-acceptance candidate. A leakage class and direction-specific test basis must be explicitly selected for this product |
| [ГОСТ34437-2018](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/238ed124-6865-4b20-a071-12e411c265fb) | Active; effective 2019-07-01; experimental hydraulic/cavitation characterization, including stop/check valve resistance | Appropriate source to investigate for a measurable resistance requirement. [Change1](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/changesdetails/9d78059a-0243-4af1-b712-d8ebbe18dce5) effective 2026-03-01; main registry also lists an entry in ИУС6-2026. Full latest body must be reconciled before clause-level claims |
| [ГОСТ15150-69](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/711fda4f-2b42-4cf9-8892-a42db255d1cb) | Active; climate, operating/storage/transport categories; change5 listed in ИУС2-2013 | Drawing notes14 and29 cite it. Preserve ОМ5 and storage designation; this review does not infer a new operating-temperature range from the climate code |
| [ГОСТ9.032-74](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/2432c5c4-dc5c-4ffa-b9be-8310e6693526) and [ГОСТ35094-2024](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/details/b46c36c3-6ff2-4484-b32f-819894115b37) | Former replaced by latter, effective 2025-02-01; new coating classification standard active | Drawing note13 cites old coating class V. Legacy-contract versus current-design edition needs decision; replacement alone does not authorize changing the drawing |

The official ГОСТ356 [2024 correction record](https://protect.gost.ru/gost/changesdetails/35d41363-f0ba-4774-b649-672ec3bba985) gives effective date 2024-05-21. A numeric pressure selected from an older scan without checking that correction would not be revision-controlled evidence.

### Pressure and flange ambiguity

The drawing's literal marking is Ру6. Keep it as a literal source annotation. Converting an explicitly specified physical quantity of 6 kgf/cm² would give 0.588399 MPa, but the drawing's unit convention and standard nominal-series interpretation must be resolved before using that as a design load.

The user-supplied repository reproduction `gost1536/gost1536.txt` shows DN200 table2 at 0.63 MPa: D295, D1 264, D2 247, 12 M14 fasteners. The geometric match supports investigation of that flange series. The same reproduction shows table3 DN200 at 1.0 MPa with D310/D1 273/D2 250 and 12 M16. These are reproduction-level observations, not independent verification of the complete official table. A flange match alone neither upgrades pressure rating nor determines maximum working, design, closure differential, surge, or proof-test pressure. This review adopts no numeric design or proof pressure.

### Manufacturer analog and limits

[Lenpromarmatura's own catalog](https://lenpromarmatura.ru/downloads/LPA_catalog_sudarm.pdf#page=54), printed p53, maps ЛПА49011-200-10 to 522-35.4179/ИТШЛ.491925.015. It lists PN6.3; candidate body БрО8ц4, cover/disc БрАЖНМц9-4-4-1, seat/spindle Сплав3М, stand Сталь20; seawater −2…+50°C. Printed p52 maps ЛПА49011-200 to suffix -01. These are catalog analogs, not this drawing's BOM, material certificates, or brine qualification. No material is selected by this review.

An indexed [Askold official catalog URL](https://www.ascold.ru/site/assets/files/1141/katalog_sta_2020.pdf) associates the same drawing family with PN10 and different masses. The current URL returned HTTP404; indexed data are recorded only as a conflicting revision/identity lead, not accepted design evidence.

### Other drawing references

Exact source details remain unverified for ОСТ5.5131-73; ОСТВД5.5131-73; РД5.35.9504-86; ГОСТ2.304-81; ГОСТ5631-79; ОСТ5.9646-75; ОСТ5.9035-80; instruction74-0603-68-81; ОСТ5.9048-85; СТП35-77-76; shock norms063-76.4.002; ОСТВ5.4347-81; МКШС-71Е; ГОСТВ15.206-84; РД5.9307-79. Preserve these as transcriptions pending authoritative copies and revision checks. In particular, C0's “ОСТ1964-75” should not be propagated; the source note13 reads ОСТ5.9646-75. The reliability calculation identifier is not sufficiently clear in the small scan for a definitive transcription.

## Unresolved critical inputs and minimum closing evidence

1. Product identity and duty: select unsuffixed base, -01, -02, or an explicitly new derivative; identify governing drawing revision, purchaser requirements, jurisdiction/classification basis. Base seawater is supported; brine duty is suffix-specific unless intentionally added as a new requirement.
2. Pressure basis: reconcile literal Ру6 with flange standard series and product revision; define rated/design pressure at each operating temperature, maximum reverse/shutoff differential, external pressure/vacuum, transient envelope, and proof-test procedure. Supply applicable ГОСТ356 text and missing base protocol Л-ПСП-4035-85 or approved replacement design cases.
3. Materials: establish a part-level material specification, casting/working route, heat treatment, properties at applicable temperatures, code-derived allowable stresses, inspection/casting-quality factors, corrosion/erosion allowance and fluid compatibility. Manufacturer analogs are candidates only. If -02/brine is selected, add verified low-temperature and brine-service evidence; base storage exposure still requires storage/return-to-service consideration.
4. Mechanism and dimensions: confirm vertical-lift stop-check arrangement and stem/disc free motion; choose or verify seat/disc/guides, lift, minimum sections, bonnet joint, bolting, seals, fits and tolerances. Keep 600* as reference until deliberately controlled in the new design. Do not carry over swing-disc formulas.
5. Acceptance: define flow range, liquid properties, installation orientation, pressure taps and resistance convention, leak class/direction, endurance cycles, shock/vibration profiles and noise measurement setup for the selected variant. The scalar coefficient6 alone does not fix those inputs.
6. Standards access and editions: obtain authorized readable full copies or an approved requirements specification for applicable clauses. Public metadata are insufficient for clause-level pass/fail or stress allowables. Official login requirement was respected; no account, payment, or paywall bypass was attempted.

## Handoff and verification

`variant_input_matrix.json` is the machine-readable variant/notes matrix. `source_manifest.json` records hashes of originals and crops. Official-viewer access-limit screenshots are retained in the private research workspace, not included as standards evidence in this delivery. Public catalog PDF and registry HTML were read-only downloads. No repository file, branch, commit, or pull request was changed by this research task.
